name: Pareto 26.10 Preview
short: Unbiased's composite multimodal preview (1M context, 131K out) for research, coding and agents; DeepSWE 69.9% at $0.24/task, preview with limited independent verification.
standout: A composite experiment: research, coding and agent skills assembled into one multimodal preview with per-task pricing.
tradeoff: Independent verification is still thin — treat both scores and pricing as provisional.
